verdict: Yes, for a patient cheesemaker. Panchal Dairy from Surendranagar pitched artisanal cheese made from pastoral milk on Shark Tank India Season 4, but didn't get a deal. Indian artisanal cheese is growing among chefs and food lovers.
angle: Indian cheesemakers use local milk from cows, buffaloes, goats and camels. Aged cheeses need time, skill and storage. Restaurants, gourmet stores and food festivals are good channels.
